about: Kwells (hyoscine hydrobromide, which is scopolamine), by brand name only, is supplied four times from December 2025 to August 2026 to a 69-year-old woman.
Travacalm HO (hyoscine hydrobromide, which is scopolamine) is supplied three times from 11 December 2025 to 5 March 2026, in the middle of a 14-month history, to a 72-year-old man.
The only hyoscine product is Buscopan Forte (hyoscine butylbromide), a different medicine for bowel cramps that is not scopolamine, so the criterion is not met.
